insert into t_cruise_point_instance( instance_id, device_mete_id, station_id, station_name, device_id, custom_id, data_format, identify_type, identify_son_type, cruise_type, cruise_id, cruise_name, cruise_content, position_type, unit, if_sy, sy_type, if_videotape, videotape_time, text_desc, sort )values
( #{TCruisePointInstance.instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TCruisePointInstance.deviceMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TCruisePointInstance.stationId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.stationName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TCruisePointInstance.customId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.dataFormat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.identifyType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TCruisePointInstance.identifySonType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TCruisePointInstance.cruiseType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TCruisePointInstance.cruiseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TCruisePointInstance.cruiseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.cruiseContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.positionType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.ifSy, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TCruisePointInstance.syType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TCruisePointInstance.ifVideotape, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TCruisePointInstance.videotapeTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.textDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TCruisePointInstance.sort, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select a.instance_id, a.device_mete_id, a.station_id, a.station_name, a.device_id, a.custom_id, a.data_format, a.identify_type, a.identify_son_type, a.cruise_type, a.cruise_id, a.cruise_name, a.cruise_content, a.position_type, a.unit, a.if_sy, a.sy_type, a.if_videotape, a.videotape_time, a.text_desc, a.sort from t_std_devicemete a LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection b ON a.device_id = b.device_id where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
select * from t_std_region a where a.up_region_id = -1
select * from t_dict_business a where a.dict_code = #{dictCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN ( ( t_cruise_plan b JOIN t_cruise_plan_attr c ON b.plan_id = c.plan_id ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task d ON b.plan_id = d.plan_id ) ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id WHERE d.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT dict_code as"cruiseType", dict_note as "cruiseTypeName", ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN ( ( t_cruise_plan b JOIN t_cruise_plan_attr c ON b.plan_id = c.plan_id ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task d ON b.plan_id = d.plan_id ) ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id WHERE a.cruise_type=dict_code AND d.task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS "Count" FROM t_dict_business WHERE dict_code IN(SELECT dict_code FROM t_dict_business WHERE col_name="cruise_type" ORDER BY dict_code)

SELECT a.cruise_type, b.dict_note AS cruiseTypeName, a.cruise_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.cruise_type = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = "cruise_type" WHERE a.instance_id=#{instanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select a.*, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName, b.analyse_type, b.is_ai, f.device_name, g.real_code, c.robot_id, IFNULL(c.inspection_name,d.preset_name) as cruiseName FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id left join (select distinct device_id,device_name from t_std_device) f on a.device_id = f.device_id left join t_std_device_attr g on f.device_id = g.device_id where a.instance_id in
#{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
select a.cruise_id from t_cruise_point_instance a where 1=1 and a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS cruiseName FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id WHERE a.instance_id = #{instanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
select b.camera_type from t_camera_preset a left join t_camera_info b on a.camera_id = b.camera_id where a.preset_id = #{presetId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select a.*, b.instance_name, b.attr_name, b.attr_value from t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_attr b ON a.instance_id = b.instance_id where a.instance_id in
#{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT DISTINCT a.device_id FROM t_device_maintenance a WHERE a.maintenance_start <= #{time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND a.maintenance_stop >=#{time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
